text:
The problem: cameras miss floods
hiding under trees and clouds.

Radar doesn't, and that's our challenge:
Dancing with the SARs.

This is DELTA PULSE:
revealing the water we cannot see.
Type in any place on Earth.

DELTA PULSE streams real NISAR data
from NASA archive
and maps the hidden water in seconds.

For example, at Mason Neck,
flooded forest grew by 40%.

Imagine fishers, farmers
and water managers

watching their wetlands breathe
throughout any storm,

DELTA PULSE:
feel the pulse of the planet's water.
